description:
Root-cause spike complete. The dirty retry prototype is not a landing candidate: it reconstructs callable and carrier authority downstream, which is why the continuation symptom remains.

Output contract
A first-class callable value has one immutable construction-owned runtime boundary. It carries the producer's actual semantic captures and physical capture slots, its resolved member set, a uniform boxed closure-call ABI, and a uniform boxed return seam. Member-specific dispatch, target ABI decoding, and return reconstruction occur only inside that boundary. A DispatchSet/callable-wide inventory remains analysis only.

First losses
1. Backend packaging rediscovers a local FunctionRef/Lambda through CallableId, expands callable-wide members, and invents capture ordinal -> target-input-prefix mappings. This discards the producer-correlated CallableFlowFact already used by transport.
2. ShapeDescr::Nothing is structural payload width zero, not semantic absence. The real lossy seam is transport's bare Position -> ShapeId map: ShapeId currently carries both structural layout and non-structural runtime-carrier presence.
3. BackendCallableCapture.transport_slot conflates a logical transport position with a physical runtime slot: Nothing has a position but no lane; native reads Some as physical presence.
4. The native/codegen surface reselects members.first() after wrapper construction, reintroducing an arbitrary target ABI for heterogeneous members.

Required model
Transport publishes TransportLayout { structural: ShapeId, carrier: Absent | ValueRef } at ABI positions. ShapeDescr remains structural-only. Runtime demand declares carrier endpoints (EntryCapture and ClosureCall callee); incoming-edge role declares callable capture; ordinary direct edges only forward carrier presence. The transport fixed point publishes immutable layout. ABI planning derives parameter lanes from layout; backend/native/interpreter consume it without scans.

Transport also publishes construction ownership from CallableFlowFact keyed by producer Value position: semantic captures, explicit physical slots, resolved members, and member role mappings. Backend maps member symbols to targets once. Native wrapper exposes only construction-level physical ABI; member adaptation stays inside its body.

Delete rather than compensate
Remove post-hoc carrier scans/forced value-lane rewrites, construction/ingress ABI rediscovery, transport_slot-as-presence, CallableId/position entry selection, and legacy singleton member ABI fields.

Proof
Use fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz plus enum_predicate_search, enum_take_drop_split, range-reduce scalar, and a heterogeneous-member construction test. Assert production transport/backend artifacts expose layout and construction ownership; run interpreter and JIT paths. Lazy sid22 descriptor tagging is confirmed correct and is not the first loss.
title: fz-k22: shared consumer bodies must dispatch closure calls through the VALUE-carried entry identity -- a static position->entry stamp is unrepresentable for type-variable arg slots
